Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using Flag-tagged POLD1. While the study discusses ubiquitination and phosphorylation of MYC, the MS dataset itself is used for identifying binding partners (IP-MS) and the PRIDE metadata explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset', thus no PTM modifiers are applied to the workflow routing.
